contentHtml:
Blizzard has released some statistics about the WoW: Forever Beta, and over 8 million characters were created!



The WoW: Forever Beta is now over and launch is less than a week away. Blizzard has now released some interesting stats from the WoW: Forever, including the massive number of characters created and total PvP kills.

Tweet #2116245690200342529


The stats include:
  • Characters Created: 8,862,354
  • Deadliest Dungeon: The Hall of Thanes
  • PvP Kills: 9,959,014
  • Skyborne: 1,889,084
  • Deadliest Creature: Kobold Miner
  • Duels Fought: 1,248,125
  • Forsaken Paladins: 612,096
  • Deaths from Falling: 1,157,204
  • Zone with the Most PvP: Hillsbrad Foothills
Are you ready for WoW: Forever on November 4th? Check out all our guides to prepare.

Midnight’s Talebound demo and November’s sweet-themed Trading Post, this week’s news is packed with helpful guides, fresh stories, new rewards, and haunting additions to your collection.

World of Warcraft: Forever Goes Live Globally November 4!

Begin your first adventure or return to a new and reimagined Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever, launching worldwide November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST. Adventure to level 60 across the original continents, discover new stories, and meet fellow adventurers in a permanent home alongside modern and Classic WoW, where community comes first, and the journey matters as much as the destination.

Click to Learn More

New Player’s Starter Guide: Welcome to World of Warcraft: Forever

World of Warcraft: Forever invites players into a reimagined original Azeroth where exploration, community, and the journey itself take center stage.

Your first steps in Azeroth begin with a few meaningful choices: how you want to play, who you want your character to become, and where curiosity will lead you. Start at level one, shape a character of your own, and learn the essentials to find your place in a world designed to unfold for years to come.

Click to Learn More

Return to Azeroth in World of Warcraft: Forever

Welcome back to Azeroth. Whether it's been a few years or many, familiar roads, old friends, and new adventures await you in World of Warcraft: Forever.

To help you get your feet on the ground and begin your adventures in Azeroth once more, we’ve put together some information you may need to return to your hero’s journey.

Click to Learn More

Watch the WoW: Forever Podcast: All About Tech

Join WoW: Forever Podcast host Countdown To Classic and special guest Shobek as they talk tech with Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield, Lead Software Engineer Ana Resendez, and Principal Software Engineer Frank Williams.

Watch the episode to get insights from the development team about World of Warcraft: Forever arriving globally on November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST!

Your Next Adventure in WoW: Forever Starts in the WoW Portal Room

Azeroth has always been more than a place to play—it is a world shaped by the people we meet along the way. The WoW Portal Room offers a starting point for making those connections, whether you’re searching for familiar camaraderie or an entirely new circle of adventurers.

The WoW Portal Room is ready to welcome World of Warcraft: Forever players and help them build on the friendships, stories, and shared adventures that make Azeroth feel like home.

Click to Learn More

Watch the WoW: Forever Short Story, “Unbowed”

Cormack, a former Scarlet Crusader in life, now raised as Forsaken, struggles to accept his undead existence.

After confronting both his past and the beliefs that defined him, he is left to ask himself: can a Forsaken still serve the Light?

Join Cormack for a special fireside telling of our newest short story, “Unbowed”.

Take the Talebound demo for a spooky spin on the Player Test Realm (PTR) and experience the Red Hollow introduction, three eerie tales across Normal, Veteran, and Heroic difficulties, and all three classes: Slayer, Inquisitor, and Witch.

Dive into the Talebound demo, try the available features, and share your thoughts. No subscription is required to take part.

title.en: Blizzard Addresses Day and Night Cycle Issues for Oceanic Players in WoW: Forever
title.es: Blizzard aborda los problemas del ciclo diurno y nocturno para los jugadores de Oceanic en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Blizzard Addresses Day and Night Cycle Issues for Oceanic Players in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Blizzard aborda los problemas del ciclo diurno y nocturno para los jugadores oceánicos en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
In the latest episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Blizzard has addressed day-and-night cycle issues for Oceanic Players in WoW: Forever.



As noted in a previous podcast episode, players in Australia can share a server with players in North America. Because of this, time zones become an issue for the Oceanic player. Do they always see the game at night during prime time, or do they get to see the game in the daytime? Lead Software Designer Ana Resendez breaks down how this works.
Ana Resendez said:
"If you [Oceanic players] have friends in NA, you can still play and group up with us. But what happens is that when you group up with someone, the server needs to choose one of our worlds for you to be placed into. We actually have Australia servers, and we could have Australian time zones in those, but what happens when you get an invite from Josh [in NA] and all of a sudden you go from night to day in a couple of seconds?"
Aggrend also chimed in to directly ask the community how they would feel about this type of system being implemented.
Aggrend said:
"How would you feel about that, Australian players? Is that a thing you'd be okay with? Would you be okay with your day and night suddenly changing whenever you change groups depending on where the group leader is located? We can make a decision and say 'yeah we're going to do that', but that might be too jarring for people, so getting feedback on that would be helpful."
So that begs the question: what would Oceanic players prefer? Let your voice be heard, and let the developers know what day and night systems you'd like to see in WoW: Forever.

title.en: Returning to Dornogal - Patch 12.1.7 Campaign Playthrough (Story Spoilers)
title.es: Regreso a Dornogal - Parche 12.1.7 Reproducción de la campaña (spoilers de historias)

summary.en: Returning to Dornogal - Patch 12.1.7 Campaign Playthrough (Story Spoilers)...
summary.es: Volviendo a Dornogal - Parche 12.1.7 Reproducción de la campaña (spoilers de historias)...

contentHtml:
In patch 12.1.7, players depart Silvermoon and return to Dornogal in pursuit of Xal'atath! Here, we showcase the story of this prologue chapter for patch 12.2.

WARNING: Patch 12.1.5 and 12.1.7 Spoilers in this post!
Table of Contents
  • Return to Khaz Algar
  • Finding Tyr
  • Exploits in Uldaman
  • Set-up for Patch 12.2

Return to Khaz Algar

Following the climactic sacrifice at the end of patch 12.1.5, the plot of Midnight rather immediately made a pivot away from the story in Quel'thalas, and back on track to Xal'atath's ongoing machinations. Thanks to a vision from Orweyna, our characters finally learned that Xal'atath is attempting to claim Azeroth's Worldsoul herself, and rushed to Arator to begin forming a plan to pursue her to the center of the planet.

Orweyna says: The goddess... she has her--we must--where is Arator?
Arator says: Orweyna! What happened?
Orweyna says: The goddess is in danger! Xal'atath has infiltrated the heart of the world!
Arator says: That must be where she sent the Devouring Host!
Orweyna says: Time is running out. The coreway of the earthen is our only chance of stopping her. Go to the earthen. See what can be done.
Orweyna says: I must speak with my people. They need to know--our goddess... our world... it cannot fall, Arator.
Arator says: We will never let that happen.
With patch 12.1.7, no time is wasted in returning us to Khaz Algar, and Lor'themar sends us to Dorgonal alongside Arator to check in on the Earthen. When we last saw them during The War Within, their people had united in defiance of the Titans' edicts, and were in the middle of clearing out the collapsed Coreway that leads down to the Worldsoul. Upon arriving, we meet with Brinthe, who reveals that they have had a number of ongoing problems in their endeavor.

Machine Speaker Gerta says: Speaker Brinthe, the Coreway excavation project progresses slowly. We are doing everything we can.
Arator says: Xal'atath is deep in the heart of the world as we speak, and the Coreway's elevator is our only means of catching up to her.
Arator says: Is there any way we can clear the collapsed passage faster?
High Speaker Brinthe says: All available earthen are applying their full capabilities to the effort, but complications arose that require a keeper to mitigate.
High Speaker Brinthe says: Tyr was summoned to assist, but has yet to arrive.
Arator says: Complications? What kind of...
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Is... is this thing on?
High Speaker Brinthe says: Dagran, is everything alright?
Dagran Thaurissan II says: No! Things are VERY much NOT alright!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: We've got a wee skardyn problem pouring out o' the Coreway passage and could use some help right away!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: GAH! GOTTA GO!
High Speaker Brinthe says: Complications, young Arator.
Arator says: Well, at least this sounds like one a sword can help with.
High Speaker Brinthe says: Begin another search for the keeper!
In addition to their need of Tyr, the Keeper we resurrected into a new body back in Dragonflight, Dagran is also in imminent need of help against void-corrupted skardyn pouring from the Coreway excavation site, so we head down into Hallowfall to help stem the tide of enemies.

After fighting off skardyn and saving the Earthen and Arathi workers, Dagran's search affirms that in order to delve any deeper into the Coreway, they will need higher security clearance. With no other problems happening with the excavation, we return with Dagran to the surface.

Dagran Thaurissan II says: Arator! Champion! Skardyn just started pouring out of the Coreway. We have to save everyone!
Reassured Earthen says: My thanks. I will not become a skardyn so quickly. I will recover.
Reassured Earthen says: Thank you. I must refocus. The skardyn cannot stop our work.
Reassured Earthen says: I require downtime. The Coreway is so near, but so far...
Dagran Thaurissan II says: I can't get the console to work. We'll find Tyr. Maybe he'll have the security clearance we need.

Finding Tyr

Back in Dornogal, we find a number of Earthen waiting around for Tyr, and find out that he has still not arrived. Unable to merely sit around, we set out with Dagran to search for him ourselves, and along the way bump into none other than Dagran's uncle, Brann Bronzebeard! Having caught him in the middle of a few delves, he joins us on the hunt for Tyr across the Isle of Dorn.

Dagran Thaurissan II says: Where's Tyr? Hasn't he arrived? Why is everyone waiting around?
Dagran Thaurissan II says: The Isle isn't small, but a titan keeper should stand out. We'll find him!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Uncle Brann! Are you looking for Tyr too?
Brann Bronzebeard says: Of course! Come on, Dagran! We have a keeper to find.
High Speaker Brinthe says: Dagran. Champion. Brann Bronzebeard. We have found the keeper.
After searching further, and speculating if he was on some grand quest, we ultimately find Tyr simply... sitting on the beach, admiring the view. Brinthe has also arrived to speak with Tyr, but she allows Dagran's request to come first, and Tyr reveals that it is not in his capacity to access the Coreway -- but it is the capacity of another Keeper.

Tyr explains that the Coreway was under the jurisdiction of Archaedas, the Keeper who we defeated all the way back in vanilla WoW as the final boss of Uldaman. During The War Within, the weekly Archive quests revealed periodic messages from Archaedas, detailing the importance of Azeroth's Worldsoul, the creation of the Worldcore to contain it, and the troubled maintenance of the Coreway by the earthen of Khaz Algar.



While Tyr himself may not be able to enter the Coreway with his own access disc, Archaedas' might, and so Tyr gives us his and sends us to Uldaman along with Brann and Dagran to retrieve it from Archaedas' corpse. The pair are giddy -- perhaps too giddy -- and set off towards Dornogal to take a teleporter to Uldaman.
High Speaker Brinthe says: Hail, Keeper Tyr. I am High Speaker Brinthe of the Council of Dornogal. Thank you for responding to our call.
Tyr says: It is an honor to meet you, High Speaker Brinthe. I will assist however I am able.
Dagran Thaurissan II says: It's so exciting to meet you, Keeper Tyr, sir! I'm Dagran. I have so many questions for you!
High Speaker Brinthe says: Indeed, we both have queries. Dagran, you have priority. What did you find that required the keeper?
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Oh, right, of course! We need to access the Coreway, but it needs a higher security disc than what we've got. Where can we find one?
Tyr says: The Coreway was Archaedas's project. His security disc would grant you the access you seek.
Tyr says: Take my security disc. Archaedas's remains are within the vault in Uldaman. This disc will allow you to find him.
Brann Bronzebeard says: Uldaman? I've been there loads of times. I can help ye find that disc, Dagran.
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Are you ready to revisit Uldaman, Uncle Brann? I can't wait to see it with you!
Brann Bronzebeard says: With Tyr's very own security disc! Think of the things we'll uncover, laddie!
Brinthe, meanwhile, stays behind to have a chat with Tyr about her doubts over his role as Keeper. The Earthen of Khaz Algar have a fraught past with their Titanforged masters, especially the namesakes of their city, Keepers Dornic and Galan, who abused them over the course of millennia. Despite this, Brinthe sees the earnestness of Tyr even with his memory loss, and endeavors to start a new and amicable relationship with the resurrected keeper.

High Speaker Brinthe says: Keeper Tyr. The last time one of your kind visited was not a pleasant memory.
Tyr says: You refer to Galan. Both Galan and Dornic lost sight of their directives.
High Speaker Brinthe says: That is a mild way to phrase our intended deactivation.
Tyr says: Their protocols are not my own.
High Speaker Brinthe says: Yet you are still a creature of great concern, Keeper. We earthen have found our own directives. We value our new freedom and understanding.
Tyr says: I... am uncertain how to proceed, High Speaker Brinthe. What do you require from me? I would prefer an amicable relationship.
High Speaker Brinthe says: Very well. What is your directive, Keeper Tyr?
Tyr says: My... directive? I do not... recall. Forgive me, my memory is...
High Speaker Brinthe says: I see. Perhaps you understand, then, the trepidation of my people.
Tyr says: I wish only to understand your people. To be an ally.
High Speaker Brinthe says: Then I believe we may continue to learn more about one another. Amicably.

Exploits in Uldaman

Upon arriving in Uldaman with Dagran and Brann, we quickly hit a snag with a sealed door. Dagran uses Tyr's security disc to open it... and ends up freeing a group of trapped goblins inside, who steal the disc and take control of the Titanforged robots inside.



Instead of coming away with Archaedas' security disc, we end up losing Tyr's as well, and so we help Dagran and Brann fight through the goblins and Titanforged to retrieve the disc. Along the way, Dagran does a number of conspicuous bits of tinkering with Titan technology, continuing his story from the Overcharged delves in The War Within and allowing us to create a makeshift fake disc to control the Titanforged instead.

Brann Bronzebeard says: Come on, Dagran! We've some rivals to take care of!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: I'm right behind you, Uncle Brann!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Right then, I'm starting to put the pieces together. Keep the constructs and goblins away!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: I cannae translate this rune here, Uncle Brann. What do you make of it?
Nifty "Two Boots" Boltdigger says: What're you doing in here? Stop riling up the constructs!
Brann Bronzebeard says: Oh, I've got this. That'll disable security in this room. Watch!
Nifty "Two Boots" Boltdigger says: I just wanted to see the sky again...
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Seems it brought more. Hang on! Let me try the prototype!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: It worked! Er, sort of.
Dagran Thaurissan II says: How fast do ye think ye can trigger more titan security measures, Uncle Brann?
Brann Bronzebeard says: I'm an expert, lad! Hey you golems, follow me!
With two discs asserting commands to them, the local Titanforged are left confused, and we enter a standstill with the goblin who has the disc. After improvising a fake catastrophe with Brann and Dagran, we're able to convince the goblin to drop the disc, allowing us to continue on to find Archaedas' body and retrieve his disc.

Carter Greaseshovel says: Great, now you've confused them! They can't take orders from two discs, dwarf!
Brann Bronzebeard says: Och, Dagran, you overloaded that old disc we had! It's going to blow any minute.
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Huh? Oh. Yes, Uncle Brann. It's probably getting warmer as we speak. We should go!
Carter Greaseshovel says: It is really warm... but I'm calling your bluff! If this thing does explode, show me!
The construct shakes off their confusion and returns to work.
Carter Greaseshovel says: Eek! I'm not staying here a minute longer!
Dagran Thaurissan II says: That was some quick thinking, Uncle Brann!
Brann Bronzebeard says: You picked up the yarn I was spinning right quick, Dagran. Good work. Now to find Archaedas's remains.
While Archaedas' body was formerly deep within Uldaman at his boss room, the goblins seem to have moved it closer to the entrance, making it much easier for us to retrieve his disc and quickly exit. Despite the incredibly brief appearance, Archaedas has received an entirely new HD model, suggesting we may see more of him in the future.

Brann Bronzebeard says: Can't believe those goblins moved ye all the way up here, Archaedas! It's been a while.
Dagran Thaurissan II says: Yes! You got it, champion! I'll open a gateway to the Archives.
Brann Bronzebeard says: We'll be back for adventures another day, Uldaman!

Set-up for Patch 12.2

Upon returning to the Vault of Memory in Dornogal, we are joined by the rest of our allies, with Tyr, Arator, and Brinthe all present. Brinthe still does not trust Tyr, but believes he is acting of his own free will, while Arator is thrilled to meet the man whose legend inspired the creation of his own paladin order, the Silver Hand.





While the cinematic that plays with the help of Archaedas' disc is currently unavailable, the dialogue afterwards implies that we not only find a way to access the Worldcore through the Coreway, but will also receive some kind of revelation regarding the Earthen that Brinthe and Dagran will be interested in uncovering.



The questline ends here, leaving us to wait until patch 12.2 to pursue Xal'atath into Midnight's final zone, the Mantle Vault. Given the obvious cliffhanger, it is incredibly likely that in addition to Arator's search for his parents, we will be joined by Brinthe, Dagran, and Tyr as they work to uncover the mysteries of the Titans amidst our fight to save the Worldsoul.

In many ways, this story feels more like a continuation of The War Within than Midnight's story, albeit with the inclusion of Arator. Regardless, the story of both expansions will finally conclude with patch 12.2, which this questline leaves us well-prepared for!

contentHtml:
Talebound has many rewards, including Venomstones, Bonus Rolls, Mythic raid loot, and experience potions!

Talebound Guide


In the latest Patch 12.1.7 PTR, many new achievements have been added for Talebound, which reward some form of player power for the main Retail game. More rewards for Talebound have been announced and previously datamined and can be seen in our Talebound guide.

Many of these Talebound rewards appear to be bought from a Travelling Raven, which can be found in Silvermoon City. Talking to this Raven also grants the Tapping at the Trader's Door achievement.

End-Game Power Rewards

Here's all the end-game gearing rewards from the Travelling Raven.
If any of your characters haven't done your Venomstone far yet, there are four achievements that each award 10 Venomstones from Venomstone Cache.
  • Heroic: The Final Confrontation's Conclusion
  • Mythic: The Final Confrontation's Conclusion
  • Veteran: The Final Confrontation's Conclusion
  • The Final Confrontation's Conclusion
Three achievements from Talebound award a Nebulous Voidcache.
  • The Inquisitor and the Scribe Complete
  • The Slayer and the Scribe Complete
  • The Witch and the Scribe Complete
There are eight total achievements that award Venomous Abyss gear. Players can get one Normal cache, five Heroic caches, and two Mythic caches.
  • Cache of Champion Treasures
    • It's Just a Normal Tale
  • Cache of Heroic Treasures
    • Heroic: The Comprehensive Final Confrontation
    • Starting Down a Veteran's Tale
    • Stepping up to a Heroic Tale
    • The Comprehensive Final Confrontation
    • Veteran: The Comprehensive Final Confrontation
  • Cache of Mythic Treasures
    • Confronting a Mythic Tale
    • Mythic: The Comprehensive Final Confrontation
Players can earn 20 Champion Crests, 40 Hero Crests, and 40 Myth Crests from Talebound.
  • Champion Mistcrest Pouch
    • Traveler's Coin Exchanged
  • Hero Mistcrest Pouch
    • Traveler's Cache Exchanged
    • Traveler's Purse Exchanged
  • Myth Mistcrest Pouch
    • Traveler's Fortune Exchanged
    • Traveler's Trove Exchanged

Non-Power Rewards

In addition to end-game power rewards, some collection items, experience pots, and profession materials are available.
Players will be able to earn a new Hearthstone, a pet toy, and a brand new Campsite!
  • Hexed Tiny Tome - Stories Shared
  • Wood-Cursed Hearthstone - The Tale Complete
  • The Fate of Quillgrave - The Final Confrontation
Players who complete each of the puzzles in a story will get a potion that grants a 10% experience boost for 2 hours. As there are four stories and four achievements, you can get 4 potions.
  • Greywake's Wisdom - The Eldrich Puzzlemaster's Reward
  • Court of Night Wisdom - The Fae Puzzlemaster's Reward
  • Greenthistle Wisdom - The Hexed Puzzlemaster's Reward
  • Darkhaven Wisdom - The Sanguine Puzzlemaster's Reward
There are two achievements that award profession materials.
  • Packed Alchemy Crate - The Arcanist's Account Complete
  • Outfitter's Crate - The Outfitter's Story Complete
Three achievements from Talebound award a Voidlight Marl Prism, totalling 7,500 Voidlight Marl:
  • A Puzzling Tale Reward
  • The Antiquarian's Chapter Complete
  • The Tale of the Puzzle Master Rewarded

Use: Unlock the Cozy Cabin Burrow house exterior for your account.


Neither item currently has a source, and the appearances of both are encrypted, so we can't see what they look like. However, it's highly likely that these two exteriors are linked to the cozy cabin decor recently datamined in a prior 12.1.7 build.

That decor is listed with the In-Game shop as a source, and players have been very vocal regarding their desire to be able to earn these new customizations in-game. It's possible that the Cozy and Icy cabins are also related to an upcoming shop pack, but it's equally possible that these could become available from the same neighborhood vendors that sell the Autumnal Westfall Barn Facade Plans and Springtime Westfall Barn Facade Plans exteriors.
